scope: Visual discrepancy audit of three central landmarks using already consulted primary photographs and the existing authored mesh. No new street-by-street inspection or measured survey.

geometry.measurementMeaning: Lengths and area calculated from OSM geometry, not independently measured physical dimensions.

mesh.interpretation: Existing authored exterior on OSM footprint; no verified field dimensions.

discrepancies.finding: Four identical upper window/balcony rows are generated on all 14 edges, including rear indentations, although only visible fronts have photographic support.
discrepancies.code: src/civic-scene.js buildHotel loop over all facadeEdges and floor<4
discrepancies.proposedAction: Author front0 and the photographed adjacent facade separately; retain other walls as explicitly unverified. Do not replicate decorative balconies throughout all recessed rear edges.

discrepancies.finding: Three repeated room balcony rows can be distinguished below an open upper gallery in the published oblique photograph; the model has four repeated rows plus an additional upper band.
discrepancies.certainty: Visual row count from this single view; not a certified floor count.
discrepancies.proposedAction: Review the 3 visible room rows and open gallery against the photo before retaining the current 6-level interpretation. No new physical height is inferred.

discrepancies.finding: Ground-floor retail bays in the model form long near-continuous reflective strips, while the reference has distinct shops, deep entrance recesses and masonry framing.
discrepancies.proposedAction: Split visible shop openings and opaque supports and give recesses actual depth; keep unknown shop identities blank rather than inventing signs.

discrepancies.finding: The present model already includes an ochre corner and top arches but its repeated small modules obscure the photographed long horizontal balconies and broad corner composition.
discrepancies.proposedAction: Preserve the broad opaque corner panel and compose continuous balcony slabs/railings; vary geometry by observed facade instead of shortening the footprint.

hotel.doNotDo: Do not shrink the building because its rotated world-axis bounding box is 83 m. The mapped front is 38.448 m and the long side 75.410 m.
hotel.sourceTagCaution: OSM height40m and3 levels are inconsistent with the current visual interpretation; neither value was verified by physical measurement.

mesh.interpretation: Existing authored exterior on OSM footprint; no verified field dimensions.

discrepancies.finding: The model fills all pointed door openings with red wood; the primary photo shows a rectangular central red door below a separate glazed/ornamented pointed transom, and side openings have distinct shutter/door colours.
discrepancies.code: src/landmarks.js frontWindow with door=true uses a complete pointed wooden shape
discrepancies.proposedAction: Separate lower timber leaves, upper pointed tracery/glazing and side shutters; do not make all portals identical red pointed doors.

discrepancies.finding: The long red spire and gothic massing already match the main identity cues; their precise proportions and all hidden rear elevations remain interpreted.
discrepancies.proposedAction: Retain the corrected silhouette and 33 m nominal OSM tag pending real measurement. Improve front openings, brick joints and cornice depths from the visible facade rather than rescaling the entire building.

cathedral.nativeScreenshotScope: The final downloaded intro looks away from the cathedral; this is a reference-versus-authored-mesh audit, not a claim of a newly captured native cathedral frontage.

geometry.measurementMeaning: Lengths and area calculated from OSM geometry, not independently measured physical dimensions.

discrepancies.finding: The shipped native view is a broad paved clearing with empty tree wells; the official fountain and hotel photos show a dense broadleaf canopy with tall palms.
discrepancies.confirmedTechnicalCause: scripts/export-unreal-landmarks.mjs explicitly omits Trees and does not call the vegetation module.
discrepancies.proposedAction: Restore native broadleaf canopy and palm assets on collision-checked provisional locations. The12 existing interior positions are interpreted, not a surveyed tree inventory.

discrepancies.finding: The exported fountain retains static civic geometry but omits animated water particles, so the photographed active jets have no counterpart in that export.
discrepancies.confirmedTechnicalCause: scene.traverse skips isPoints; provenance omits Animated fountain particles.
discrepancies.proposedAction: Use a native fountain system inside the existing basin; mark the 6.2 m radius, 0.25 m rim, 2.5 m jets and provisional centre as estimates.

santander.doNotDo: Do not fill streets or the whole park with invented buildings, impose uniform grass, or claim exact surveyed tree positions.

nextEvidenceNeeded: Orthogonal facade photographs or a licensed measured survey to certify physical heights, setbacks and openings.
